SELECT
  MAX(subq_10.first_buyer_count) AS first_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_10.first_order_count) AS first_order_count
  , MAX(subq_17.repeat_order_count) AS repeat_order_count
  , MAX(subq_24.valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_buyer_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."member_first_valid_order" member_first_valid_order_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', first_ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'
) subq_10
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN case when first_seq > 1 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders_valid_ranked" orders_valid_ranked_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'
) subq_17
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'
) subq_24
answer: 2026年7月（2026-07-01至2026-08-01），在青禾全部成交门店范围内、按 CRM 会员账户统计：观测期首购会员数为473个账户（在全部测试覆盖期内首次有效订单落入7月的账户数，不代表终身首购）；观测期首单数为473单（即每个首购账户对应的第一笔有效订单，两者一致）；观测期后续购买订单数为29,524单（各账户第二笔及以后的有效订单按订单日期落在7月计数）；有效订单数为29,997单（状态为已支付且实付金额减退款金额大于零，取消和全退不计）。首单数与后续订单数相加等于有效订单数，口径自洽。本次查询未附加门店或地区筛选，结果为青禾整体数据。
question: 2026年7月青禾的观测期首购会员数、观测期首单数、观测期后续购买订单数、有效订单数分别是多少?
